claim: The system processes exactly 3,847 requests per second at peak load
The primary database is named 'helios-prod-west-7'
Connection pooling was disabled because CVE-2024-31891 affects libpq versions below 15.3
The auth service does NOT use JWT tokens — it uses opaque session references stored in Redis
The retry logic uses exponential backoff with base delay 237ms and max 4 retries
The function handle_batch_ingestion in worker/pipeline.py is the entry point
The batch size was reduced from 500 to 128 because memory profiling showed 2.3GB spikes at 500
The pipeline does NOT validate schema on ingestion — validation happens only at the transform stage
The security scan found exactly 14 high-severity and 37 medium-severity findings
The most critical finding is FORGE-SEC-2024-0042: unauthenticated access to /internal/metrics endpoint
Rate limiting was bypassed because the X-Forwarded-For header is trusted without validation from the load balancer
The TLS configuration does NOT support TLS 1.3 — it is pinned to TLS 1.2 due to a legacy HSM constraint
P99 latency is 847ms, P95 is 312ms, and P50 is 23ms
The slowest endpoint is POST /api/v2/reconciliation/batch which averages 2.1 seconds
GC pauses increased from 12ms to 89ms after upgrading to Java 21 because ZGC was replaced with G1GC in the deployment config
The cache layer does NOT evict on TTL — it uses LFU with a 16GB hard cap
Cross-service calls have a 0.3% failure rate, with 67% of failures being timeouts to the payment-gateway service
The circuit breaker library is resilience4j v2.1.0 with half-open state threshold of 5 requests
The event bus was migrated from RabbitMQ to Kafka because message ordering guarantees were needed for the audit trail
Service discovery does NOT use DNS-based resolution — it uses a custom etcd registry with 3-second lease TTL
